flags.description: In-app ONE Assistant. It answers only when this is on, ASSISTANT_ENABLED=true on the server, a provider key is set and the kill switch is not engaged.
Global AI kill switch. On means every AI feature and the in-app assistant are stopped. Releasing it needs a second person.
Offer students the full job-role catalogue (108 roles, each labelled with its release status). Off: only the starter roles are offered.
Accept employer access requests from public webmail addresses (flagged for review). Off: a work email is required.
Let students share verified per-skill evidence with an employer for one application, and let that employer read it (ADR-043, hard gate HG-4). Off: nothing is offered or shown.

Let students opt in to be found by verified employers, and let those employers search the talent pool and invite them to apply (ADR-044, hard gate HG-4; consent wording HG-6). Off: nothing is offered or shown.
